name: Romania
gaps: SOR reports 19 branches and two school groups nationally; only five carry a branch page of their own on sor.ro, so the rest are covered by the national society entry rather than listed separately.
sor.ro serves a 403 to non browser clients, so its pages were confirmed by opening them rather than by curl.

groups.name: Romanian Ornithological Society (SOR)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, with nineteen branches and school groups across the country.

groups.name: Milvus Group
groups.blurb: Bird and nature protection association running surveys, ringing and volunteer field work from Targu Mures.

groups.name: Ornitodata
groups.blurb: SOR's national sightings platform, where birders in Romania log and browse their records.

groups.name: SOR Bucuresti
groups.blurb: The society's Bucharest branch, running local outings, counts and volunteer projects in the capital.

groups.name: SOR Cluj
groups.blurb: The society's Cluj territorial office and branch, one of its two main national bases.

groups.name: SOR Iasi
groups.blurb: The Iasi branch, based at the biology faculty of Alexandru Ioan Cuza University.

groups.name: SOR Brasov
groups.blurb: The society's Brasov branch, organising local bird monitoring and outings in the southern Carpathians.

groups.name: Cercul de Ornitologie Baia Mare
groups.blurb: SOR's Maramures branch, an ornithology and environment circle based at the Baia Mare children's palace.

name: Greece
gaps: Crete has an active birding scene but no club with a page of its own was found, only site guides and tour listings.
The Hellenic Ornithological Society coordinates roughly sixty trained volunteer monitors nationally rather than through named local branches, so most regions are covered by the national entry.

groups.name: Hellenic Ornithological Society (HOS)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, the only Greek NGO working solely on wild birds.

groups.name: Hellenic Bird Ringing Centre
groups.blurb: The national ringing scheme, independent since 1989, with about sixty active ringers and trainees.

groups.name: BirdWING (BirdWatching In Northern Greece)
groups.blurb: Birdwatching network for northern Greece, with site guides, records and volunteer projects.

groups.name: Antikythira Bird Observatory
groups.blurb: The society's migration monitoring station, staffed each season by volunteers and ringers.

groups.name: Birding in Greece
groups.blurb: Public group where Greek birders share sightings, photographs and identification help.

groups.name: Kalloni Environmental Information Center
groups.blurb: Lesvos birding centre at Kalloni, running walks, ringing sessions and events on the island.

groups.name: Lesvos Birdwatching
groups.blurb: Island birding community sharing sightings and news from one of Europe's best migration spots.

name: Chile
gaps: REDAVES, the Coquimbo region bird observation and conservation network, is real and covered in the Chilean press, but redaves.cl is now a parked Dynadot domain serving a "website coming soon" page, so no working link exists for it.

Regional nuclei beyond Valparaíso, Metropolitan, and Los Lagos have limited online documentation. Atacama, Coquimbo, Bio Bio, Araucania, and southern regions lack identified club websites or Facebook pages with current activity.

Dropped for lack of a presence of their own: eBird Chile (eBird region page, not a community); Núcleo ROC Valparaíso in Valparaíso (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL); Núcleo ROC RM in Metropolitan Region (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL); Núcleo ROC Los Lagos in Los Lagos (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL)
Dropped, the social page cited did not exist (soft 404 behind a 200): Grupo de Ornitólogos del Maule

groups.name: Red de Observadores de Aves y Vida Silvestre
groups.blurb: The national birdwatching network, open to amateurs and scientists alike, and eBird's Chilean partner.

groups.name: Unión de Ornitólogos de Chile
groups.blurb: The Chilean ornithologists' union, publishing the country's ornithological journal and records.

groups.name: Atlas de las Aves Nidificantes de Chile
groups.blurb: The national breeding bird atlas, mapped by volunteer observers across every region of Chile.

groups.name: Censo Neotropical de Aves Acuáticas
groups.blurb: Chile's arm of the neotropical waterbird census, counted twice a year by volunteers at wetland sites.

name: Peru
gaps: COAP Cusco runs a Facebook group at facebook.com/groups/coapcusco, but it is a vanity group URL sitting behind a login wall with no visible name or member count, and no press or search result quoting its content was found, so it was left out rather than listed unverified.
Regional ornithology clubs operate mainly through Facebook and informal networks rather than dedicated websites. COAP has Lima and Cusco chapters but no central site.

groups.name: CORBIDI
groups.blurb: Biodiversity research centre whose ornithology division runs Peru's bird records committee.

groups.name: Unión de Ornitólogos del Perú (UNOP)
groups.blurb: The Peruvian ornithologists' union, publishing a peer reviewed bulletin for the country's bird research.

groups.name: Club de Observadores de Aves del Perú (COAP)
groups.blurb: National birdwatching club with chapters in Lima and Cusco, organising outings and counts.

groups.name: Grupo Aves del Perú
groups.blurb: Association founded in 1995 for the study and conservation of Peru's wild birds.

groups.name: PAU Arequipa
groups.blurb: The urban birds programme in Arequipa, monitoring city birds with students, birders and residents.

name: Tanzania
gaps: Zanzibar Birdwatching Society (ZABISO) is a real, community based group but its domain zabiso.org now serves a parked, ad injected redirect page, so no working link was found for it.
Kilombero Valley Ornithological Centre's older domain kvoc.co.uk no longer resolves; the working link is its current site.

No independent bird club with its own site or verifiable social presence found for Arusha, Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar beyond the countrywide Birding Tanzania Facebook group; Nature Tanzania's own site describes itself as the only bird focused conservation NGO in the country.
Tanzania Bird Atlas's site only resolves over plain http, not https.

groups.name: Wildlife Conservation Society of Tanzania
groups.blurb: Membership conservation society that has long run weekend bird walks around Dar es Salaam.

groups.name: Nature Tanzania
groups.blurb: The country's bird focused conservation NGO, working with local groups on surveys and education.

groups.name: Tanzania Bird Atlas
groups.blurb: The national atlas, mapping distribution from records sent in by observers across Tanzania.

groups.name: Birding Tanzania
groups.blurb: Public group where Tanzanian birders post sightings, photographs and identification queries.

groups.name: Kilombero Valley Ornithological Centre
groups.blurb: Community based centre in Ifakara running bird surveys and conservation projects in the Kilombero valley.

name: South Korea
gaps: No city or provincial birding club with its own live website could be verified; Korean birding organises around a few national bodies and online communities rather than a local club network.

groups.name: Birds Korea
groups.blurb: Busan based conservation organisation working on birds and habitats of the Yellow Sea eco region.

groups.name: Ornithological Society of Korea
groups.blurb: The national ornithological society, publishing the Korean Journal of Ornithology twice a year.

groups.name: Saerang
groups.blurb: Korean birdwatching community and records platform, with sightings, a species guide and local birders.

groups.name: Korean Birding Association
groups.blurb: Association promoting birdwatching in Korea, with outings, records and identification resources.

groups.name: Korea Wild Bird Association
groups.blurb: Long running wild bird association running surveys, protection work and member activities.

groups.name: Bird Research Center, Korea National Park Service
groups.blurb: National park service centre running ringing and migration monitoring that volunteers take part in.

groups.name: Nationwide Bird Watching
groups.blurb: Open nature recording mission where Korean birders log their sightings together.

name: Malaysia
gaps: MNS Johor Branch is listed by the society at mnsj.org.my, but that domain does not resolve, so the branch is not listed here.
MNS Penang Branch is active but has no website or public page of its own that could be found, only a postal address.
Sandakan Borneo Bird Club is real and works with Sabah Tourism on birding guides, but has no findable page of its own.
mns.my and mnsselangorbranch.org sit behind Cloudflare and return 403 to non browser clients; both were confirmed by opening them.

groups.name: Malaysian Nature Society
groups.blurb: Founded in 1940, the country's oldest nature society and BirdLife partner, with branches in every state.

groups.name: MNS Selangor Branch
groups.blurb: The society's largest branch, running outings and nature activities across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

groups.name: MNS Bird Group
groups.blurb: The Selangor branch birdwatching group, known as PiedFantail, with a regular programme of bird walks.

groups.name: MNS Perak Branch
groups.blurb: Ipoh based branch safeguarding Perak's natural heritage, with birding and nature outings.

groups.name: Sabah Birdwatchers Association
groups.blurb: Kota Kinabalu association running shorebird and raptor workshops, field trips and bird fairs.

groups.name: MNS Miri Branch
groups.blurb: The society's Miri branch in northern Sarawak, posting outings and nature activities for members.

name: Philippines
gaps: The Wild Bird Club of the Philippines runs nationally from birdwatch.ph rather than through chartered local chapters, so no separate regional club pages were found for Cebu, Davao or Negros.

groups.name: Haribon Foundation
groups.blurb: The BirdLife partner in the Philippines, with member volunteers working on forests and birds.

groups.name: Wild Bird Club of the Philippines
groups.blurb: Nationwide club of birdwatchers running guided trips, the national checklist and the Philippine Bird Festival.

name: Indonesia
gaps: Around fifty local birdwatching communities are reported across Sumatra, Java and Kalimantan, but most organise on WhatsApp and closed groups; only those with a public page of their own are listed here.
Pertemuan Pengamat Burung Indonesia, the national birders' gathering, has no permanent site of its own and appears only as event coverage, so it was left out.
Yayasan Kutilang Indonesia's old domain kutilangindonesia.or.id no longer resolves; its working presence is the blog listed here.
burung-nusantara.org, which used to carry a directory of Indonesian birding groups, no longer resolves.

groups.name: Burung Indonesia
groups.blurb: The BirdLife partner in Indonesia, with membership, surveys and conservation work across the archipelago.

groups.name: Jakarta Birdwatcher's Society
groups.blurb: Active since 2005, monitoring Jakarta's city birds and running naturalist walks in the capital's green spaces.

groups.name: Paguyuban Pengamat Burung Jogja
groups.blurb: Umbrella community for Yogyakarta's bird observers, running the monthly Jogja Bird Walk and ringing sessions.

groups.name: Yayasan Kutilang Indonesia
groups.blurb: Grew out of Indonesia's first birdwatching club, now a bird conservation foundation based in Yogyakarta.

groups.name: KPB BIONIC UNY
groups.blurb: Student bird study group at Yogyakarta State University, running expeditions, raptor watches and surveys.

name: Thailand
gaps: The Thailand Birding Club runs inside BCST rather than as a separate body with its own page, so it is covered by the BCST entry.
No provincial bird club with a page of its own was found for Chiang Mai, Phuket or the northeast; the birding sites there are personal guides and trip report blogs rather than clubs.

groups.name: Bird Conservation Society of Thailand
groups.blurb: The BirdLife partner, founded as the Bangkok Bird Club, running trips, records and the national bird list.

groups.name: EcoThailand Birdwatching Club
groups.blurb: Foundation run club on Koh Phangan, taking students and residents out on island bird counts.
